scope: Read-only source accounting and shutdown preflight, completed after final receipts became available; not a prospective freeze. No source or existing result file changed.
source_review_observations: reconcile_tonight.py combines the continuation total (which already includes the first sprint) with only the new ablation total. It neither adds the first sprint a second time nor adds workflow RPC attribution.
The three local receipts each display a reserve for context. The combined arithmetic uses only compute totals and adds one $25 global reserve; those three local reserve fields are not summed.

Every recorded app cost matches lifetime times the frozen maximum container count times $0.00139376 per container-second, with a positive difference below $0.000001. The broker samples time separately for ended and cost, explaining these small conservative differences.

The continuation shutdown snapshot is explicitly a union of older stopped-app observations and the final v4 observation. Both original listing hashes and every union row agree with shutdown-evidence-provenance.json. It is not represented as one fresh listing of all eight apps.
Historical app.json status="running" fields are retained launch snapshots. Final zero-task stopped observations and broker-closed receipts supersede them.

reconcile_tonight.py trusts local receipt totals and shutdown booleans; it does not itself enumerate all launches, recompute every app lifetime, or validate underlying snapshot hashes. This independent review checked those prerequisites for all eight current apps. This is a general hardening opportunity, not an observed mismatch in tonight's receipts.

The closeout engineering audit and experiment-specific readiness are separate. This review binds the passed collection receipts but does not re-run all raw inference audits or reclassify any failed scientific gate.

These are conservative app-wall estimates under the recorded rate policy, not invoices, account credits, or a claim that the $25 reserve has already been spent. No cloud query, inference, or shutdown action was performed by this reviewer.
